Bráhmans. Nearly all but that of holding the plough
Pennecar a 2d sort. Same, but in a lower line
Stanicas. Employed in low offices at heathen temples
Moylar. Similar to the Stanica, No. 6.
Mussulmans. Exclusive of Moplays, and artists
Pomebut. Attendants on the idols of destructive spirits
Baat. Persons employed by the great to sing their praises
Biluaras. People who extract the juice of palms
Bedor. A savage race, who eat cats, and with great propriety are called murderers
Kshatriyas (pretenders to the 2d. cast). Messengers, robbers, &c.
Cabbadi. Sellers of butter, and milk
Currey Cudemdaer. A low cast of cultivators
Malay-cudis. Cultivators living on the hills
Autgar. A sort of actors, who represent the ancient wars of India
Comutty (Vaisyas). Merchants of the 3d pure cast
Pacanat. Collectors, and venders of drugs
Gursor. A set of people living in forests, on what they can procure wild there
Telinga Bulgewars. Traders, and labourers. Teliga Banijigaru of Karnata
Cunabi. Farmers of pure Súdra descent
Busive (Baswa). Prostitutes of the sect who worship the Linga
Mallewar. Farmers, who wear the Lingam
Killabund. Architects, literally constructors of forts
Jilligar. People who search wells, and tanks for lost money
